module.purpose: Provides the Redux combineReducers utility that turns a map of slice reducer functions into a single reducer, with development-time validation and warnings.
module.summary: This file implements the Redux combineReducers function. It accepts an object whose values are slice reducer functions and returns a single composite reducer. The composite reducer invokes each slice reducer with the corresponding slice of state and the action, assembling a combined state object with the same keys. It performs development-only checks: asserting that every slice reducer returns a defined initial state and handles unknown actions correctly, warning about unexpected state keys or missing reducers, and preserving referential equality by returning the previous state reference when nothing changed.
module.businessContext: Core Redux state composition utility. Enables modular reducer design. Failure breaks store initialization or yields incorrect state shapes.

specLiterals.value: The slice reducer for key "${key}" returned undefined during initialization. If the state passed to the reducer is undefined, you must explicitly return the initial state. The initial state may not be undefined. If you don't want to set a value for this reducer, you can use null instead of undefined.

specLiterals.value: The slice reducer for key "${key}" returned undefined when probed with a random type. Don't try to handle '${ActionTypes.INIT}' or other actions in "redux/*" namespace. They are considered private. Instead, you must return the current state for any unknown actions, unless it is undefined, in which case you must return the initial state, regardless of the action type. The initial state may not be undefined, but can be null.

detail.name: combineReducers
detail.signature: export default function combineReducers<M>(reducers: M): M[keyof M] extends Reducer<any, any, any> | undefined ? Reducer<StateFromReducersMapObject<M>, ActionFromReducersMapObject<M>, Partial<PreloadedStateShapeFromReducersMapObject<M>>> : never
preconditions: The reducers argument must be an object whose values are reducer functions or undefined.
Each reducer value, when invoked, must not return undefined for a given state and action.
postconditions: The returned combination function produces a state object having the same keys as the provided reducers map.
Each slice of the resulting state is the output of invoking the corresponding reducer with its previous slice state and the dispatched action.
If any slice reducer returns undefined, an Error is thrown describing the offending key and action type.
The shape assertion captured during combineReducers setup is rethrown by the returned combination function before any reducer is invoked.
invariants: finalReducers only contains entries whose values are functions.
The returned state object is rebuilt from scratch on every dispatched action.
The combination function never returns undefined as the overall state.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: If a reducer key maps to a non-function value, it is ignored and a warning is emitted in development builds.

stateMutations: finalReducers: populated once during combineReducers setup with function-valued entries from the input reducers map.
unexpectedKeyCache: created and mutated only in non-production builds to suppress duplicate warnings about unexpected state keys.
shapeAssertionError: assigned once from the try/catch around assertReducerShape during setup.
detail.summary: Given a map of slice reducers, returns a single combined reducer that invokes each slice with the corresponding state slice and the incoming action, building a new state object shaped like the reducers map.

detail.signature: function combination(state: StateFromReducersMapObject<typeof reducers> = {}, action: Action): StateFromReducersMapObject<typeof reducers>
preconditions: Each registered slice reducer must return a non-undefined value for the dispatched action.
The shapeAssertionError from assertReducerShape must be null (i.e., reducers passed shape validation).
environment.NODE_ENV must be defined (either 'production' or otherwise) for branch evaluation.
postconditions: Returns nextState object containing one key per finalReducerKeys with values from each slice reducer.
If any slice reducer returns undefined, throws an Error before completing iteration.
hasChanged tracks whether any slice state reference changed from previous.
invariants: nextState always contains exactly the keys in finalReducerKeys.
No slice key in finalReducers may yield undefined from its reducer.
previousStateForKey passed to each reducer is the prior slice value for that key.
Action object passed to every slice reducer is the same reference received by combination.
edgeCases: state defaults to {} when called without prior state.
If shapeAssertionError was captured, it is re-thrown immediately before processing reducers.
In non-production builds, warnings are issued via getUnexpectedStateShapeWarningMessage for unexpected state keys.
If action.type is falsy, the thrown Error message references '(unknown type)' instead of the type string.
If a reducer returns undefined for a known action.type, the Error message includes the quoted action type string.
